assumptions: All original source Claim assumptions retained
Stiffness selected by predeclared rational margin, not measured
payload.context: Two illustrative mathematical stiffness candidates under one already published exact Claim context; not measured fish biology, collective benefit or biological validation.
limitations: Imported record of what the producer's receipt reports. Frontier did not execute this and no one has re-run it; the producer's own code produced both the claim and the result, so it is not independent evidence.
The request is labelled by its producer: DECLARED ILLUSTRATION: not produced by the dx-guilds solver; numbers are test values, not a design claim. Its numbers are test values, not a design claim.
EI is an ASSUMED log-spaced range (1/1000000 to 1 N m^2), not a measurement of any fin ray.
Producer states it does not establish: biological feasibility of any fin, ray or flight design
Producer states it does not establish: the stiffness EI of any real fish fin ray (it is an assumed range here)
Producer states it does not establish: fluid-structure interaction: the load is a fixed mean pressure proxy, not coupled to deformation
Producer states it does not establish: fin membrane, bilaminar hemitrich shear, active muscle control, ray taper, joints or viscoelasticity
Producer states it does not establish: large-deformation (elastica) behaviour: results beyond the declared small-deformation limit are flagged invalid
Producer states it does not establish: calibration of rho, CL, tributary width or ray length (all declared, none measured)
Producer states it does not establish: that the glide package's candidate is flyable (owned by the glide receipt, not by this package)
No acceptance by producing actor; separate operator review required

source.access: Reference metadata only; actual generated bytes retained in the committed artifact directory; publication/availability projection is separate
